descriptionChirho: Aramaic noun שְׁנָה (shenah): a unit of time spanning twelve months. S142824 covers singular construct forms ('in the year of', 'year of') while S142826 covers the plural ('years'). All translations map to the same lexical concept: eng 'year/years', spa 'año/años', hin वर्ष, arb سَنَة/سِنِين, kor 해/해들, swa mwaka/miaka. The split is purely inflectional (singular vs. plural number), not a difference in meaning. Both appear in Daniel's chronological references.
